expectedRealization.rationale: The Dec environmental capacity hit can affect TiO2 price/margins inside one quarter, but the preferred company's M&A/goodwill/cash risks prevent a bounded Primary route.

acceptableExpressionSet.rationale: Baililian/Longmang is the largest direct integrated TiO2 expression and had lower 60d absorption than Annada, but negative operating cash flow, RMB4.62bn goodwill and material acquisition/debt complexity block Primary.

changeHypothesis.summary: A new Dec environmental capacity disruption hit roughly 11% of the TiO2 chain on top of an already-known 2016 price upcycle. Baililian has direct integrated scale/resource exposure, but the merger dramatically increased balance-sheet complexity.
changeHypothesis.persistenceReason: Environmental restrictions and low inventories can support prices through the base horizon, while integrated ore capacity can mitigate raw-material inflation.
disconfirmingEvidence: The old TiO2 upcycle and multiple prior price hikes were already known.
Goodwill was about RMB4.62bn after the Longmang acquisition.
Short-term borrowing and acquisition financing rose materially.
Annada had stronger price absorption, showing the theme was not hidden.

evidenceLedger.supportsClaim: A new environmental capacity disruption tightened an already-rising TiO2 market.
Baililian has direct profit sensitivity but major cash/M&A/balance-sheet risks.
The pre-event baseline already included many 2016 price hikes and a company price/target snapshot.
A cleaner peer was already expected to turn profitable from the old TiO2 price cycle.
The TiO2 basket showed an early 20d turn but mixed 60d absorption.

expectations.measurableGap: Freshness and low 60d absorption create headroom, but balance-sheet/M&A risk prevents bounded downside sufficient for Primary.
